mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuations and encourage risk-taking.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 10.0% (UNRATE > 10.0) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it signals economic distress and potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) where retail sales are rising while industrial production is declining signals a recovery in consumer demand despite ongoing industrial weakness, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction between INDPRO and RSAFS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03, or the positive return rate in triggered instances is less than 55%.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-shock recovery regime, a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates persistent labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate slower economic recovery.
failure_condition: In the post-shock recovery regime, the Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03, or the negative return rate in triggered instances is less than 55%.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it signals a contraction in manufacturing and overall economic activity.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 60-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between INDPRO and 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level above 1200.0 thousand units signals a strengthening in the residential construction sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates broader economic recovery.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE >= 10.0%) signals an aggressive monetary policy response to a severe recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate a policy-driven recovery.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03, or the positive return rate in triggered instances is less than 55%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 256.0 (index 1982-1984=100) in the prior month signals strengthening inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in a robust economic recovery without immediate monetary tightening concerns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 256.0, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03.
